jobs.prompt: Vertical key art for a dark fantasy tower-defense game. A giant weathered ivory stone die with dark hollow pips rests on top of the crumbling keep of a ruined medieval castle on a lonely mountain peak. Storm clouds, a few crows, faint cold moonlight from above, mossy cliffs and a winding stone path up the mountain, dark pine forest below. Composition: the die and castle fill the upper two thirds, centered; the lower third is a darker misty valley with calm empty space reserved for UI. Cinematic, high detail on the die and castle.

Wide key art for a dark fantasy tower-defense game. A giant weathered ivory stone die with dark hollow pips rests on top of the crumbling keep of a ruined medieval castle on a lonely mountain peak, exactly centered. Storm clouds and crows above, faint cold moonlight, jagged mountain ridges and dark pine forest stretching left and right, a winding stone path up the mountain. The lower quarter is darker mist with calm empty space reserved for UI. Cinematic, high detail on the die and castle.
